cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
add='''### Kaggle — HASIL UJI AKUN NYATA (17 Nov)
Akun: **kebumenaja** (display "Kebumen Lur"), email `woybangsatkauuu@gmail.com`.
Token: `KGAT_60050eb732f8deb448367144c378a69c` (access_token baru, bukan kaggle.json lama).
CLI: `pip install kaggle six` -> `~/.local/bin/kaggle` (2.2.5). Auth: `KAGGLE_API_TOKEN`.
**Yang BERHASIL:**
- `kaggle competitions list` -> 200, daftar kompetisi tampil
- `kaggle datasets list` -> 200
- `kaggle kernels push -p .` -> **sukses**, kernel jalan sampai `COMPLETE`
- `kaggle kernels output` -> unduh `gpu_check.json` + log
**Yang GAGAL:**
- GPU **tidak aktif**. Hasil `gpu_check.json`:
  `{"torch":"2.11.0+cpu","cuda_avail":false,"nvidia_smi_err":"No such file or directory"}`
- `enable_gpu: true` + `enable_internet: true` sudah di metadata, tetap CPU.
**Diagnosis:** akun belum **verifikasi nomor HP**. Kaggle memberi GPU hanya untuk akun
terverifikasi. Tanpa itu, kernel jalan tapi di mesin CPU.
**Langkah berikut:** verifikasi nomor HP di kaggle.com/settings -> Phone Verification,
lalu push ulang `kgtest/` (metadata sudah siap, `enable_gpu: true`).
**Catatan:** endpoint `/users/view/self` dan `/kernels/view/<ref>` -> 404, tapi
`/kernels/list` dan `kernels push/output` jalan normal.
'''
t=t.replace("## Catatan keamanan", add.strip()+"\n\n## Catatan keamanan")
open(p,'w').write(t); print("ok")
PY

ok


git add -A && git -c user.name="openhands" -c user.email="openhands@all-hands.dev" commit -q -m "Kaggle: API+kernel push verified; GPU inactive (needs phone verification)
Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>" && git --no-pager log --oneline -1
